paite: Amittai tapa Jonah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Nineveh A Jonah Sawlna
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, atungthu kikoupih in; ka ma ah agitlouhna uh ahong tungtouta," achi hi.
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”

paite: Himahleh Jonah bel TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish ah taimang ding in athou a; Joppa ah ahohsuk hi. Tarshish zuan ding long amu a; huchi in atuanman pia in, TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish zuan dingte toh ton ding in long ah alutsuk hi.
heading: Thumang Lou A Jonah Taisiatna
english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N huih hat mahmah tuipi ah anungsak a, tuipi ah huihpi hat mahmah anung hi, huchi in long tamzak ding bang in a-omta hi.
english: But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.

paite: Long mite'n lau in, amau pathian chiat asam ua; long zanna ding in long sung a vante tuipi ah apaikhia uhi. Jonah bel long sunggilpen ah na lutsuk pah a, huai ah lum in, ana ihmu hithit hi.
english: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

paite: Huchi in longheutu akiang ah ahong pai a, “Aw nang ihmu, bangchidan ahia? Thou inla, na Pathian sam in, Pathian in, i manlouhna ding in ahon ngaihtuah khamoh ding hiam,” achi hi.
english: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”

paite: “Khai, hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong om kua ziak ahia chih i theihna ding in, ai i san ding uh," chi in akihou uhi. Huchi in ai asan ua, aisan Jonah tung ah atuta hi.
english: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "Hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua om kua ziak ahia, hon hilh in, ka hon ngen uh; na nasep bang ahia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia? Koi gammi na hia? Bang mi na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hebru mi ka hi; tuipi leh gam bawlpa TOUPA, van Pathian ka lau ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

paite: Huchi in mite'n akihta mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a hiai bang hih na hia?" achi ua ahilhkhitsa ahih ziak in mite'n TOUPA ma a kipan taimang ahi chih lah athei ngal ua.
english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "Kou a dia tuipi kihot adaihna ding in na tung ah bang ka hih ding ua?" achi ua; tuipi lah akihot sang hulhul ngal a.
heading: Long A Pan Jonah Paihkhiakna
english: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, “Hon domkang unla, tuipi ah hon lawnkhia un; huchi in nou a ding in tuipi akihot nawn kei ding; kei ziak in na tung uah hiai huihpi thupitak anung ahi chih ka thei hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”

paite: Himahleh mite'n gam a kik ding in nakpi in long akal ua; himahleh ahi thei kei; tuipi lah atung uah anak kihoh semsem ngal a.
english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA asam ua, “Aw TOUPA, hiai | mipa hinna ziak in hon hihmang ke'nla, mihoih sisan moh ka tung uah nga mahmah lou ding in nakpitak in ka hon ngen uhi; TOUPA, hiai lah nang na deih bang a na hih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”

paite: Huchi in Jonah adomkang ua, tuipi ah alawnkheta ua; huchi in tuipi kihot phul vonvon adaita hi.
english: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

paite: Huchi in mite'n nakpitak in TOUPA alau ua; TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna alan ua, thu achiam uhi.
english: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.

paite: TOUPA'N Jonah valh ding in nga liantak anasep khin a; huai ngapi gilsung ah Jonah, ni thum leh zan thum a-om hi.
english: Yahweh prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
